### Root Cause (1 issue — all 3 errors stem from it)

**`Services/Services.csproj` is missing a `PackageReference` for `Newtonsoft.Json`.**

`Services/UserService.cs` uses `Newtonsoft.Json` (`using Newtonsoft.Json` on line 2, `using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq` on line 3, `JObject` on line 22), but the project file has no such dependency:

```xml
<!-- Services.csproj — current -->
<ItemGroup>
  <ProjectReference Include="..\Core\Core.csproj" />
</ItemGroup>
```

### Cascading Failures

All 3 errors are **CS0246** in `Services.csproj` — they are all caused by the same missing package. No other projects have independent errors. `Api.csproj` depends on `Services.csproj` but didn't produce additional errors (the build likely short-circuited).

### Fix

Add a `PackageReference` to `Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.*" />
</ItemGroup>
```
